APPROVE. The extracted helper keeps the original loop bounds, check order and `break` conditions (each `break` becomes `return -1`, and the colon match returns `k - 1`), so behaviour is unchanged. Removing the loop, nested ifs and `||` chain from `ArrowParameterRange` should bring it under 15, and nothing in the diff, such as the XML doc comment or the `IReadOnlyList<JsToken>` parameter, should break a warnings-as-errors build.

I judged this from the diff alone and did not build the project or measure the complexity. I also could not see how `close` is initialised before the `else`, and I assumed it starts at -1.
